summary_zh: 今日無新痛點，三項既有痛點持續升溫：成衣大廠儒鴻訂單能見度已達明年第二季，產能與人力壓力浮現；美國調整對加拿大關稅範圍，鋼價升至多年新高，牽動採購成本。越南修訂投資法轉向重視技術轉讓與質量，日本FDI推動綠色轉型，華商需提早因應減碳合規。
summary_en: No new pains; three recurring ones rose. Eclat's order visibility reaches Q2 next year, straining capacity and labour. US tariff changes on Canada pushed steel to multi-year highs. Vietnam's investment law revision favours quality and tech transfer, while Japanese FDI drives green transition.
